Subject: Billing cadence & onboarding materials (Lumenix)
Attachments: lumenix_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf; proposed_payment_schedule.xlsx; lumenix_w9.pdf

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. As discussed, we started the vendor setup and attached the completed onboarding form, our W-9 and a suggested payment schedule. A quick note on terms: our standard is Net 45, but given Redwood's monthly close we wanted to request Net 30 to align invoice receipt to your accounts-payable cycle.

If Net 30 isn't possible at onboarding, would Redwood consider an interim arrangement where invoices submitted by the 5th of the month are paid by the 30th, consolidated monthly? That helps our cashflow without changing longer-term contracts.

Next steps from our side: complete any vendor portal fields you need us to populate and we can sign an amendment via DocuSign if required.

Best,
Ana Costa
Head of Finance Operations
Lumenix Inc.
Payables: payables@lumenix.com

--
Lumenix attachments: vendor onboarding form (PDF), proposed payment schedule (XLSX), W-9 (PDF).

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence & onboarding materials (Lumenix)

Ana —

Thanks for the form and the clarity. Confirming receipt of the attachments. We're open to aligning cadence; procurement needs to run the onboarding checklist and finance needs to confirm any amendment to standard payment terms. I've looped in Priyom (Procurement) and Marissa (Billing) to help with the operational details.

High-level ask from our side: can you confirm whether Lumenix can accept a single consolidated invoice per month (covering all deliverables within that month) and whether you can invoice by the 5th for the prior month? That maps cleanly to our AR/AP schedule. Also please include bank remit details on the invoice (ACH routing + account name).

I'll draft the DocuSign amendment for the term change once procurement confirms the PO flow. If we need interim language (e.g., invoices submitted by the 5th will be paid by the 30th), we can include that as a temporary clause.

Thanks — talk soon.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Ana / Grace —

Thanks — quick procurement checklist to keep things moving:
- Vendor onboarding form completed (received).
- W-9 on file (received).
- Tax / regulatory review (no concerns).
- PO creation: we will issue PO-8342 to Lumenix once contract terms are finalized.

On the invoice cadence: Redwood prefers consolidated monthly invoices for platform services. We can accept invoices for the prior month submitted by the 5th; those will flow into our AP run for 30-day payment. A couple of clarifying questions:
1) Do you need multiple invoices per month for different cost centers, or can you accept a single combined invoice line-item per region/product?
2) If Lumenix wants to keep Net 45 on the Master Services Agreement, but accept a Net 30 operational cadence (submit by 5th / paid by 30th) for the first 3 months, would that work from your side? That would reduce contract churn while solving timing misalignment.

Also, Marissa — can you confirm whether we need any additional PO metadata for Coupa (tax code, remit-to ID)? I'll pause the PO until we have the legal language agreed.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom / Grace —

Thanks for the checklist — we can definitely accept a single consolidated invoice per month with line items summarized by product. We typically generate one invoice for platform services + any usage adjustments. Submitting by the 5th for the prior month is feasible for us.

About the contract language: we can keep Net 45 on the Master Services Agreement but add an operational amendment that invoices submitted by the 5th will be paid within 30 days of receipt for the first 90 days post-onboarding. If everything aligns on both sides, we can revert to Net 30 on the MSA at the first renewal.

I've attached bank_remit_details.pdf (stub) to include on invoices and I can sign the amendment in DocuSign — send the link when ready.

Best,
